subject: Saturn's moon Titan: thick orange haze, a huge ringed Saturn in the sky, dark methane lakes on an orange icy landscape.

variants.prompt: The astronaut WITHOUT a spacesuit, wearing only an oxygen mask, a puffy red winter coat and homemade feathered bird wings strapped to his arms, flying joyfully over a methane lake, grinning.
Close-up of the astronaut without a spacesuit, wearing an oxygen mask and a puffy red winter coat with frost on it, huge delighted grin and wide eyes, Saturn looming behind him.
Split composition: on the left the astronaut sweating inside a bulky spacesuit; on the right the same astronaut relaxed on Titan in just a winter coat and oxygen mask, giving a thumbs up.
The astronaut in a red winter coat and oxygen mask sinking into a dark methane lake, only his shocked face and one raised hand above the surface, Saturn in the orange sky.
